events.info: Ameristar Kansas City Star Pavilion presents Christmas Together with Shooting Star & Missouri Live in Concert Dec. 5, 2026 Door @ 7:00pm, Show @ 8:00pm Ages 18+ unless accompanied by an adult. Enjoy one of Ameristar's restaurants before the show! Secure covered parking is always free at Ameristar. Want to make a night of it? Book a hotel room at https://ameristarkansascity.boydgaming.com/ or call 816-414-7000 No refunds or exchanges. All sales are final.
